$comment: The release-candidate tag the compat CREDENTIAL lanes run against (ADR-0056). null = no RC cut yet: the credential crons refuse rather than test main. Cutting an RC is a founder action: push the vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag, then bump rcTag here in a reviewed PR. scripts/compat-credential-ref.mjs resolves it.
$rcBumpMarkerComment: #1302 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/compat-credential-freeze-guard.yml refuses any PR touching a file the credential harness executes (derived, see docs/ci/credential-freeze-guard.md), unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: rcBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...', paths?: ['exact/frozen/path', ...] }. #1635: a marker exempts only the PR that introduces it (absent at that PR's merge base, or a new date/reason); a marker inherited from main exempts nothing, and a pin-only PR that just removes or shortens the marker passes without one. #1641: a PR changing rcTag fails unless that tag already exists on the remote and is reachable from main.

rcBumpMarker.reason: founder-approved freeze exception 2026-10-07: K1 __NEXT_TEST_MODE in vinext harness. scripts/e2e-deploy-vinext.sh now exports __NEXT_TEST_MODE=e2e before the vite build (as cloudflare/vinext#2875 did for vinext's own deploy suite) so vinext compiles in the test-only next-test-fetch-priority header app-prefetch/prefetching asserts. Scoped to this one frozen file plus the pin file; rcTag unchanged.

$publishedBytesBumpMarkerComment: #1663 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/published-bytes-freeze-guard.yml packs the publishable group at a PR's own merge ref and diffs it against the pinned rc tag's already-packed tarballs, unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: publishedBytesBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...' }. Same #1635 introduced-by-this-PR rule as rcBumpMarker. Remove once the pinned rcTag itself moves to the new rc (PR B, #1660).

publishedBytesBumpMarker.reason: C1 (server-action redirect fetch-status, vinext#3689): adds one new bundled vinext fix to @getknext/core's templates/vinext-patches/ (a published-bytes change) — vinext-3689-action-redirect-fetch-status.patch, which makes a fetch-invoked server action's redirect() always answer HTTP 200 (matching current Next.js) instead of sometimes falling back to 303, ahead of its upstream vinext release. Also touched: templates/vinext-patches/manifest.json (the new patch's entry + the new pristine sha256 for dist/server/app-server-action-execution.js, additively merged forward over the C5/#1860 entries) and src/__tests__/vinext-patches.test.ts (two behaviour tests). Distinct reason from the inherited C5/#1860 marker on this same pin file, so the #1635 introduced-by-this-PR rule reads this as new, not inherited.
